description: TCE test profiles for `/skill:test --type`. `full` is deliberately omitted so a bare invocation resolves to the genuine full CI suite (`npm --silent test`) and populates the audit-accepted full-suite cache entry. See the sibling SKILL_PREFIX.md for the stage-selection policy. Every typed Vitest command defaults `GAMES_CONFIG` to `full` (preserving an explicit override), mirroring the project shell runners (`run-ci-tests.sh`, `run-smoke-tests.sh`, …) so game-discovery adapters load — without it a bare `/skill:test --type unit` fails Golf's replay tests with "Available adapters: none" (CG-0MUIXVIBP0062A8H). Browser-dependent types also chain scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts before Vitest; every typed Vitest command runs through scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts (attribution-aware retry-once + wall-clock hang timeout) with the default reporter (human summary + retry detection) plus the flat-TAP reporter (scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts) so red runs triage per test.

unit: bash -c 'export GAMES_CONFIG="${GAMES_CONFIG:-full}"; npx tsx scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts --project unit --timeout-ms 300000 --reporter=default --reporter=./scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts'
smoke: bash -c 'export GAMES_CONFIG="${GAMES_CONFIG:-full}"; npx tsx scripts/check-browser-test-env.ts && npx tsx scripts/vitest-run-with-retry.ts --project smoke --reporter=default --reporter=./scripts/vitest-tap-reporter.ts'
